_comment: What to run instead of each retired /pb:* command. migration_guide.py check fails while a command that shipped in any release since v1.2.0 is gone and has no entry here.
build-check-design-system: `/pb:build` — the DS-first check is §3a of the build loop, automatic
data: `/pb:plan --data` (first authoring; `/pb:build` keeps the `erd` slice in sync after that)
flow: `/pb:plan --flow` (first authoring; `/pb:build` keeps the `flow` slice in sync after that)
snapshot: no command — `/pb:update-version` backs up `registry.json` before it writes (`--rollback` restores it); keep other history in git
sync-erd: `/pb:plan --data`, or nothing: `/pb:build` reconciles the `erd` slice on every trio write
sync-flow: `/pb:plan --flow`, or nothing: `/pb:build` reconciles the `flow` slice on every trio write
